CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dsr_cases ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, case_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, investor_unique_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, jurisdiction VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_description TEXT NOT NULL, requester_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, requester_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, requester_phone VARCHAR(64), requester_role VARCHAR(64), supporting_file_path VARCHAR(512), status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, sla_deadline TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, assigned_to VARCHAR(255), resolution_notes TEXT, resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_dsr_cases_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_dsr_cases_case_id UNIQUE (case_id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_cases_investor_unique_code ON dsr_cases(investor_unique_code); CREATE INDEX idx_dsr_cases_status_sla ON dsr_cases(status, sla_deadline);
